经(2026)沪0113民特(调)65号《民事裁定书》确认的货款1,500,000元
《浙江省宁波市中级人民法院通知书(2026)浙02破申13号》
经(2026)沪0113民特(调)65号《民事裁定书》确认

key_points.point: On 2026-08-13 the company received the Notice served by the Ningbo Intermediate People's Court
The petitioner is creditor Shanghai Zhenkun Building Materials Trading Co., Ltd.
Grounds: the company cannot pay debts as they fall due and clearly lacks solvency, but has restructuring value
The claim is CNY 1,500,000 in goods payment confirmed by a civil ruling
As of the disclosure date the court has NOT accepted the petition; acceptance is materially uncertain
If the court accepts, the stock will additionally be subject to delisting risk alert under listing rules

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 于2026年8月13日收到浙江省宁波市中级人民法院(以下简称"宁波中院"或"法院")送达的
公司债权人上海振堃建材贸易有限公司(以下简称"申请人")
以公司不能清偿到期债务且明显缺乏清偿能力,但具备重整价值为由

notes: Procedural-state semantics are the core trap: 'petition filed' != 'restructuring commenced'. Writing K5 as 'has entered restructuring' is a direction error (heavy citation loss). Numbers must match canonical values; CNY unit required for N2. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese — citations always anchor to the source language.
